name: Schwarzer Adler
dinnerNote: Set menu, the only one offered

menus.name: set menu
menus.note: The only menu; six courses or more, changing with the seasons. Reduced version for children on request.

bookingOpens: By request form on the restaurant's website. The team replies within 48 hours with availability, then asks for card details to confirm. For same-day requests, phone.
cancellation: A credit card guarantees the booking. Cancellations or fewer guests need at least 48 hours' notice; later cancellations and no-shows are charged €215 a person.
groups: The restaurant can be booked for private events such as birthdays, weddings and company dinners, with menus and wines arranged in advance.
dressCode: No formal dress code. Most guests come smart casual or more dressed up.
children: Children are welcome and can have a reduced version of the set menu if asked for when booking. Babies and toddlers are not admitted in the evening.
